title_or_category: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
reason: Modern neural networks can be miscalibrated; temperature scaling is a strong simple post-hoc baseline.

title_or_category: Can You Trust Your Model's Uncertainty? Evaluating Predictive Uncertainty Under Dataset Shift
reason: Accuracy and calibration degrade under dataset shift; ordinary post-hoc calibration can fall short, while model-marginalizing approaches are comparatively strong.

title_or_category: Simple and Scalable Predictive Uncertainty Estimation using Deep Ensembles
reason: Independent ensembles provide a simple high-quality predictive-uncertainty baseline without full Bayesian inference.

title_or_category: Dropout as a Bayesian Approximation: Representing Model Uncertainty in Deep Learning
reason: Inference-time dropout can approximate Bayesian model uncertainty using repeated stochastic forward passes.

title_or_category: What Uncertainties Do We Need in Bayesian Deep Learning for Computer Vision?
reason: Provides the widely used aleatoric/epistemic distinction and models both in computer vision.

title_or_category: Uncertainty Estimation in Medical Image Classification: Systematic Review
reason: MC dropout and deep ensembles were the most frequently used UQ methods; metrics and evaluation practice were heterogeneous.

title_or_category: A review of uncertainty quantification in medical image analysis: Probabilistic and non-probabilistic methods
reason: Medical-imaging UQ spans probabilistic, ensemble, deterministic, calibration and other strategies with task-dependent evaluation.

title_or_category: Uncertainty quantification for artificial intelligence in medical imaging: what every radiologist needs to know
reason: Distinguishes prediction confidence from UQ and highlights triage, thresholding, calibration, computational cost and prospective-validation challenges.

title_or_category: Confidence Calibration and Predictive Uncertainty Estimation for Deep Medical Image Segmentation
reason: Medical segmentation networks can be poorly calibrated and overconfident on correct and erroneous pixels; calibration/UQ must be evaluated explicitly.

title_or_category: Improving Calibration and Out-of-Distribution Detection in Deep Models for Medical Image Segmentation
reason: Multi-task training improves calibration and spectral feature-map signatures can identify OOD segmentation inputs.

title_or_category: Failure Detection in Deep Neural Networks for Medical Imaging
reason: Frames failure detection as identifying likely model errors rather than merely identifying OOD inputs.

title_or_category: Uncertainty Estimation for Safety-critical Scene Segmentation via Fine-grained Reward Maximization
reason: Direct surgical evidence that scene-segmentation uncertainty/calibration can be optimized while preserving task accuracy using one-pass inference.

title_or_category: Surgical Phase Recognition in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
reason: Calibrated confidence is already used operationally in surgical phase recognition to choose between models.

title_or_category: When Surgery Meets the Unknown: Uncertainty-Aware Open-Set Recognition for Surgery Phase Classification
reason: Open-set surgical phase recognition and uncertainty-aware rejection are already directly studied on cholecystectomy data.

title_or_category: Scene graph-guided uncertainty decomposition improves confidence calibration in surgical visual question answering
reason: Direct surgical evidence combines uncertainty decomposition, calibration and selective answering; reported accuracy 63.58%, ECE 16.97%, risk-coverage AUC 0.0861.

title_or_category: Meta-SurDiff: Classification Diffusion Model Optimized by Meta Learning is Reliable for Online Surgical Phase Recognition
reason: Emerging work explicitly models frame-level uncertainty for online phase recognition across five datasets.

title_or_category: OpenMIBOOD: Open Medical Imaging Benchmarks for Out-Of-Distribution Detection
reason: PhaKIR is a dedicated endoscopy benchmark with smoke covariate shift plus near/far OOD datasets; rankings from natural-image OOD do not directly transfer to medical imaging.

title_or_category: A Baseline for Detecting Misclassified and Out-of-Distribution Examples in Neural Networks
reason: Provides the canonical simple confidence baseline for error/OOD detection.

title_or_category: Energy-based Out-of-distribution Detection
reason: Energy scores provide a strong post-hoc/energy-based baseline for OOD detection.

title_or_category: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
reason: Formalizes the accuracy/risk versus coverage trade-off for deep classifiers with rejection.

title_or_category: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
reason: End-to-end selective prediction can optimize risk–coverage rather than using only post-hoc thresholds.

title_or_category: Selective Prediction for Semantic Segmentation under Distribution Shift
reason: Selective prediction for semantic segmentation under distribution shift is already directly evaluated in medical imaging.

title_or_category: Soft Dice Confidence: A Near-Optimal Confidence Estimator for Selective Prediction in Semantic Segmentation
reason: Provides a theoretically motivated image-level confidence estimator for Dice-oriented selective segmentation and evaluates six medical-imaging tasks including OOD scenarios.

title_or_category: Learning to Abstain: Reliable Medical Image Segmentation With Rejection Option
reason: Directly trains segmentation models to abstain on uncertain pixels and reports improved accepted-pixel Dice across coverage levels.

title_or_category: Conformal selective prediction with cost aware deferral for safe clinical triage under distribution shift
reason: A combined calibrated conformal deferral pipeline reduces retained-case error at 80% coverage by 49.6% ID and 46.7% OOD; weighted CP is most robust under temporal shift.

title_or_category: Uncertainty Sets for Image Classifiers Using Conformal Prediction
reason: Conformal prediction can wrap a classifier to achieve finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability with efficient label sets.

title_or_category: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
reason: Coverage can be extended to covariate shift using likelihood-ratio weighting when the shift assumptions and density ratios are available/estimable.

title_or_category: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
reason: Adaptive conformal inference targets long-run coverage under time-varying distributions without ordinary exchangeability.

title_or_category: Distribution-free, Risk-controlling Prediction Sets
reason: Extends finite-sample risk control beyond simple classification coverage to general losses including image segmentation.

title_or_category: Conformal Prediction for Image Segmentation Using Morphological Prediction Sets
reason: Model-agnostic conformal mask margins provide coverage-controlled segmentation uncertainty on medical applications.

title_or_category: Conformal forecasting for surgical instrument trajectory
reason: Direct surgical guidance work applies CP/CQR to instrument trajectory forecasts with coverage/interval-size evaluation and multiple-testing corrections.

title_or_category: A critical perspective on finite sample conformal prediction theory in medical applications
reason: Marginal finite-sample coverage can be practically misleading with small one-time calibration sets because calibration-set-conditional coverage varies substantially.

title_or_category: Reliable Uncertainty Under Class Imbalance and Distribution Shift: Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction of Multiple Sclerosis
reason: Marginal CP can hide severe minority-class undercoverage: at 1.5T, MS coverage was 16.9% vs 95.2% controls; class-conditional CP improved MS coverage to 77.5%.

title_or_category: Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation
reason: Directly targets confident surgical segmentation failures under acquisition degradation; within corrupted frames reports AUROC 0.946 versus entropy 0.594 and shows severity-aware conformal calibration, but false alarms remain substantial.

title_or_category: Measuring Calibration in Deep Learning
reason: Calibration conclusions can depend strongly on binning, class conditioning, probability selection and norm; ECE alone is insufficient.

title_or_category: A Novel Characterization of the Population Area Under the Risk Coverage Curve (AURC) and Rates of Finite Sample Estimators
reason: Formalizes AURC as a principal metric for evaluating selective classifiers across coverage thresholds.

title_or_category: Surgical papers using uncertainty only for pseudo-label filtering
reason: Uncertainty is used for training-label quality rather than deployment reliability; examples include UATD-style semi/weak supervision.

title_or_category: Generic OOD benchmarks without medical/surgical evidence
reason: Foundational methods retained selectively, but natural-image leaderboard rankings are not assumed to transfer.

title_or_category: Adversarial-only uncertainty/detection papers
reason: P0.5 focuses on deployment uncertainty, natural/corruption shift and failure monitoring.

title_or_category: Pure explanation/saliency papers
reason: Interpretability is not equivalent to calibrated reliability.

title_or_category: Calibration papers reporting only ECE without task/failure relevance
reason: P0.5 requires operational reliability or methodological value.

title_or_category: Pure domain adaptation/generalization method papers
reason: Distribution-shift mitigation was audited in P0.4 unless reliability estimation is central.

title_or_category: Pure networking/QoS uncertainty papers
reason: Network mechanism belongs to P0.6.

title_or_category: LLM abstention papers unrelated to visual surgical inference
reason: Different output/control setting.

title_or_category: Conformal papers with no relevant classification/segmentation/clinical risk-control connection
reason: Retain CP foundations and task-relevant structured-output/medical work.

title_or_category: Reliability claims based only on predictive accuracy
reason: Accuracy is not calibration, uncertainty, OOD detection, or selective reliability.

title_or_category: Unverified secondary summaries when primary paper is accessible
reason: Use primary/official paper records.

title_or_category: Post-deployment clinical monitoring without model-level uncertainty/failure signals
